name: Test Classmap Cleanup for PHPUnit Tests
description: Removes stray PSR-4 class maps of disabled modules from Drupal's classloader during PHPUnit runs.
project_description:
Tecla is a very simple PHPUnit test helper tool. It provides a workaround for unnecessarily registered classes of disabled/uninstalled extensions what happens if you are running PHPUnit tests (see [#2006476].).

 The workaround is pretty simple: it is driven by a service provider which removes the appropriate PSR4 mappings from Drupal's class loader. The solution uses reflectors, so it has some performance impact, but the benefit is a more realistic behavior during testing.
